```{=html}
<h1 class="gcpp-hero__h1">NAS&#8209;China Track</h1>
```

::: {.gcpp-hero__lede}
Turn your interest in understanding China into a well-rounded research portfolio. NASC seeks to develop rigorous, original scholarship on China among a new generation of Indian researchers, at a time when understanding China has never been more consequential for India's foreign policy, economic strategy, and national security.
:::
:::
:::
:::

```{=html}
<!-- ============ RESEARCH DOMAINS ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section">
  <div class="gcpp-container">
    <span class="eyebrow">Research domains</span>
    <h2 class="gcpp-h2">Propose your own topic</h2>
    <p class="nasx-prose" style="margin-bottom:24px;">This is a general call for research proposals. Fellows are not required to work on pre-assigned themes. You propose a topic within the broad domain of China studies, including the following areas.</p>
    <ul class="unit-list">
      <li><span class="u">C.01</span> China's political system, governance, and the Chinese Communist Party</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.02</span> China's economy, growth model, structural challenges, and industrial policy</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.03</span> China's foreign policy and global ambitions</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.04</span> The Belt and Road Initiative and China's overseas presence</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.05</span> China's military modernisation and the PLA</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.06</span> India–China relations, border, trade, and strategic competition</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.07</span> China's technology policy, AI, semiconductors, digital infrastructure, and clean-tech</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.08</span> Taiwan and cross-strait relations</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.09</span> China and the Global South</li>
      <li><span class="u">C.10</span> Chinese society, nationalism, and public opinion</li>
    </ul>
    <p class="nasx-prose" style="margin-top:24px;">As part of the fellowship, fellows will have access to the <strong>Open Takshashila Expert Capsule Course (ECC)</strong>. Fellows can choose to enrol in any of the ECCs running during the fellowship period, currently spanning subjects like China, Geospatial Technology, Space Power, and AI.</p>
  </div>
</div>
```

```{=html}
<!-- ============ APPLICATION PROCESS ============ -->
<div class="gcpp-section">
  <div class="gcpp-container">
    <span class="eyebrow">Application process</span>
    <h2 class="gcpp-h2">How to apply</h2>
    <div class="apply-list no-codes">
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Proposal & Statement of Purpose</h3>
          <p>Submit a research proposal of 1,000–1,500 words outlining the topic, the research questions, and the approach. Proposals should clearly identify the gap in existing scholarship and explain why the topic merits sustained attention. Applicants are also required to submit a 500–800-word Statement of Purpose explaining their reasons for pursuing a fellowship in this domain. Only one author per proposal will be accepted.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Interviews</h3>
          <p>Submitted proposals undergo internal review, and applicants whose proposals are shortlisted will be invited to a virtual interview.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="apply-item">
        <div class="body">
          <h3>Fellow announcements</h3>
          <p>Up to 6 selected candidates will be invited to join the 2026–2027 NAS fellowship cohort.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>
```
